hypotheses.A: Feasible wrong proposals plus joint-state propagation explain excess N10; contiguous N10 frames are not independent intervention events.
hypotheses.B: Selective uncertainty/ownership/global-regret gates preserve baseline-correct tracks better than forced identity authority.
hypotheses.C: Joint-state matched training transfers better than target-only training.
hypotheses.D: Trajectory-aligned benefit/harm supervision better separates interventions than single-frame candidate correctness.
hypotheses.E: Anchor/base agreement and calibrated NONE reduce unavailable-target takeover at nonzero useful coverage.
hypotheses.F: Committed-only independent pending/trusted writes can improve retention without reinforcing rejected proposals.
hypotheses.G: Sequence-isolated expanded TRAIN and fixed density strata expose transfer and coverage failures.
hypotheses.H: Small scalar/logistic/ranker controls may outperform unnecessary complex controllers.

new_split_rule.source: Actual readable official DanceTrack40TRAIN inventory, before new policy effects
new_split_rule.missing_candidates: Generate only selected TRAIN groups incrementally; never reshuffle because of measured performance
new_split_rule.confirmation_runtime_access: Only once after model/threshold/operating-point source and SHA freeze

episode_rule.old_pilot: Keep both original deterministic clicks for reproduction
episode_rule.expanded_train: At most3 eligible identities per sequence, sorted by first eligible visible frame then official sequence-local ID. Initial box height>=48 and width>=16; initial observed candidate IoU>=0.5 required, missing initial candidate is failure and not a replacement.
episode_rule.initialization: SIMULATED_ONE_CLICK_FROM_GT; immutable RGB OSNet crop at sole event frame only
episode_rule.whole_video: Every original frame, independent full joint multi-object rollout for each one-click episode

candidate_policy: Same sealed real SAM3/OSNet UID/geometry-filtered input; no GT-created candidates; recovery changes labelled separately and require TRAIN coverage bottleneck evidence.
runtime: Current/past only, original exact joint solver unchanged, complete unique ownership, actual committed observation feedback, no retroactive output edits.

metrics.confidence_intervals: Paired sequence-cluster bootstrap2000, seed72114; average seeds and episodes inside sequence, not independent frames/seeds.

event_definitions.divergence: First current candidate->public ownership difference from independently evolved C0, not necessarily first harmful event.
event_definitions.N10: C0 strictly correct clicked UID identity and treatment not strictly correct, after sole click.
event_definitions.direct_harm: Current intervention changes treatment's own KEEP assignment from target-correct to incorrect (posthoc truth only).
event_definitions.propagation: Subsequent N10 with no new directly harmful intervention is a state-history-associated diagnostic, not a causal-origin proof.
event_definitions.causal_root: Only same-prestate cloned independent future branches can establish an onset's counterfactual contribution.
event_definitions.harm_runs: Maximal contiguous N10 frames, with explicit duration/right-censoring; runs are not interchangeable with harmful intervention onsets.
event_definitions.non_target_damage: Baseline-origin identity proxy and distinct affected public IDs; not distinct people or net harm unless measured.

search.conditional_family: Relational attention/backbone adaptation only after R0-R8 diagnosis and failed justified simple models; record prereg amendment before any new effect.
search.bounded_search: At most64 deterministic predefined TRAIN-INNER configurations per fixed family; no full Cartesian blind search.
search.selection: INNER safety lexicographic: global correctness, nonvacuous intervention, harmful onsets/collateral risk, N01-N10, then AssA/HOTA. Keep failure controls and all seeds.
search.early_stop: Max30 epochs, patience5 INNER, finite gradients/checkpoint logs, best INNER and latest resume

gates.gate0: A/A and shadow unchanged, one click, all frames, exact globally unique solver, no GT runtime, pre-event equality, isolated branches and committed-only bank.
gates.gate1: Real useful accepted interventions; N01>N10 and beneficial independent onsets>harmful onsets; no severe non-target damage. Always KEEP is not PASS.
gates.gate3: All operating points/models frozen before one-time independent TRAIN confirmation; historical25VAL is not virgin.

progression: A-H inexpensive diagnostics required; bounded TRAIN pilots when supervision exists; expand only after useful direction/global safety; an individual model failure does not close all branches.
stop: Stop unsafe/OOM/nonfinite experiment and retain failure; all feasible preregistered branches exhausted or documented unavailable before final classification. No next stage automatic.
github_delivery: Code/tests/necessary small Goal/protocol/research summary/manifests only; local data, media, embeddings, large traces, weights and bulk experiment files not uploaded.
